fields.name: label
fields.label: Small label above the heading
fields.description: For example: PAY ONLY FOR WHAT YOU USE

fields.name: steps
fields.label: Steps
fields.description: One bulleted list. In each bullet: the step title in bold, then its text. The numbers are added automatically.

fields.name: example
fields.label: Example card
fields.description: In this order: Heading 3, a note paragraph, then one bulleted list for the table. First bullet = column headings (bold first heading, second heading, third heading in italic). Each row = bold days, amount, interest in italic. The LAST bullet is the total row: bold label, total in italic.

fields.name: comparison
fields.label: Comparison boxes and text below the table
fields.description: In this order: a bulleted list with two bullets for the comparison boxes (text, then the amount in bold, e.g. With your LAS limit ₹2,939), an explanation paragraph, and a last small disclaimer paragraph.
